Hi Olivia — thanks for sending these over. Quick confirmations and next steps below.

1) Methods accepted: ACH (ACH CCD) and wire (FedWire). We can support both; ACH will be our normal cadence.

2) Remit reference: please put Redwood PO followed by invoice number in the invoice reference field. Our preferred parsing token is exactly: PO#<number> (example: PO#123456). If you can include that in the invoice XML or on the invoice PDF it will auto-map to the PO in our finance system.

3) Onboarding form: I attached our Redwood_Payee_Onboarding_Form.pdf — please complete pages 2–3 (tax/EIN confirmation and remit preference) and return. We need a signed copy on file before first payment.

4) Micro-deposits: we will run two micro-deposits to the ACH account you provided for verification. Expect them in 1–2 business days. Please confirm when you see them (amounts will be < $0.50).

5) First pay run: Provided the form + micro-deposit confirmation, we can include Papertrail on the 8/05 pay run. If you need an earlier wire, indicate 'URGENT: WIRE' in reply and include wire fees contact.

Attachments: Redwood_Payee_Onboarding_Form.pdf (form), onboarding-checklist.txt

Thanks —
David Kim
